overall: Los Angeles is in a typical marine-influence morning pattern: temperatures peaked early (~01:55 ET) at 69.8°F and have since trended down to 66.2°F with a cooling velocity of -1.8°F/hr as the overnight marine layer deepens. Conditions are partly cloudy with a moderate onshore west-southwest flow (~7 mph), consistent with a classic June Gloom/marine layer setup that should burn off mid-morning before afternoon heating. No tropical or severe weather context affects the LA basin directly; the Extreme Heat Watch from NWS San Diego targets inland mountain zones, not coastal LA.
